method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Cremation Act 1929 (WA), compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 37196, retrieved 2026-09-07; compilation table to the Public Health (Consequential Provisions) Act 2016, Reprint 6 as at 27 Oct 2017; s 285(2) of that Act uncommenced and not reflected), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_37196.txt; with the Cremation Regulations 1954, version 04-o0-00, currency from 1 Jul 2026 (mrdoc 49624, retrieved 2026-10-20; Sch 2 as amended by SL 2026/112: permit fee $89.10 in ordinary hours, $147.40 otherwise), as deposited at ../../../cremation-regulations-1954/registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_49624.txt

scope: s 2 (administrator), s 3(1), s 7, s 8(2), (3A), (3B), (4A), (5), (6), s 8A(a)-(g), ss 9, 10, 12, 13(1), (2), 14, 15(1); Cremation Regulations 1954 r 11, 12, 14(2), (4), Sch 1 Form 9 (24 hours), Sch 2 item 3. Not encoded: licensing and revocation (ss 4-6, 16), appointment of referees, s 3(2) and regs Part V, s 8B (stillborn children), the crematorium's register and notices, s 17.
seat: the family member or executor arranging a cremation
